title: Dex Agents CLI session settings
description: The settings of one session that a Dex Agents CLI command runs: the JSON object that start_session and update_session_settings store, at most 16 KiB. They override the configuration file from the next turn on. model and system_prompt replace the file's values. connectors.enabled may only narrow the file's connections and tools, approval.always only adds tools that need approval, and local_tools may only switch tools off or shrink the shell allow list. An omitted field keeps the file's value; there are no defaults here. Other top-level keys belong to other readers of the settings: they are ignored and reported as warnings, so they never fail a turn. Unknown keys inside a known field are errors. Settings that fail this schema or try to widen the file are rejected as a whole, and the turn fails with the error. A session without settings uses the file as it is. Settings are stored in the session, so they never hold secrets.
$comment: The $defs shared with config.schema.json must stay identical to it; the tests in agents/cli/tests check them.

system_prompt.description: Replaces the file's system_prompt or system_prompt_file.

enabled.description: Replaces the file's list, which bounds it. Each entry must fall inside one entry of the file: the same connector, the same connection unless the file's entry names none, and a subset of the file's operations unless the file's entry lists none. When the file omits connectors.enabled, any list narrows it. An empty list: no connector tools.

connectors.description: Narrows the file's connectors. connectors.mcp is fixed by the file.

always.description: More tools whose every call waits for approval, added to the file's approval.always.

local_tools.description: Each field may only switch off what the file switches on, or repeat the file's value.

files.description: false switches the file tools off; true only repeats the file's true.

enabled.description: false switches shell commands off; true only repeats the file's true.

allow.description: Replaces the file's allow list. Every command must be in the file's allow list, compared as exact strings.

web_fetch.description: false switches web fetching off; true only repeats the file's true.

browser.description: false switches the browser off; true only repeats the file's true.

model.description: A model ID in the harness's own format, such as claude-opus-5-5 or openai/gpt-5-mini. Any non-empty string; the harness checks it.

tool_name.description: A tool name: 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, or dots.

operation_name.description: A connector operation: its snake-case name, such as get_message, or its operationId, such as getMessage. Both spellings name the same operation: an operationId is compared after the connectors library's lowerCamelToSnake conversion, which keeps acronym runs together, so listStoryIDs is list_story_ids and getHTTPResponse is get_http_response.

connector_key.description: A connector ID, or connector/connection. A connection name has at most 256 characters, no slash, no control character, and no leading or trailing space, as Dex Web requires.

tools.description: The connector operations the agent may call, by snake-case name or operationId. Two entries must not name the same operation.
